description: Create a Tripsy transportation for point-to-point movement. Timed values are always UTC ISO-8601 timestamps; set departure_timezone and arrival_timezone to each endpoint's local IANA timezone. MCP clients displaying transportations must convert departure_at with departure_timezone and arrival_at with arrival_timezone before formatting local endpoint dates/times. Use transportation_type for the segment kind and include departure/arrival names, addresses, latitudes, and longitudes when known. Store provider-issued reservation, confirmation, or booking codes in provider_reservation_code; use transport_number for the flight, train, bus, or service number. For flights, use transportation_type airplane, set departure_description and arrival_description to airport IATA codes, include the airports' departure/arrival latitudes and longitudes, and omit name unless the user provided one. For transfer activities, use transportation_type transfer and fill both departure and arrival locations completely. Supported transportation_type slugs: airplane, bike, bus, car, roadtrip, cruise, ferry, motorcycle, subway, train, transfer, walk. Labels: airplane = Flight; bike = Bike; bus = Bus; car = Car Rental; roadtrip = Drive / Road Trip; cruise = Cruise; ferry = Ferry; motorcycle = Motorcycle; subway = Subway; train = Train; transfer = Transfer; walk = Walk. Use only these exact slugs; custom categories are not supported for transportations. Safety: Closed-world: operates within the authenticated user's Tripsy account and accessible trips.

arrival_address.description: Full arrival address. Required for transfer activities when known.

arrival_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 arrival timestamp when known. Timed values are always UTC; MCP clients must convert this value to arrival_timezone before displaying the local arrival date/time.

arrival_description.description: Arrival location name or description. For flights, use the arrival airport IATA code such as JFK or FCO. For transfers, include the real place name.

arrival_latitude.description: Arrival latitude. Required for flight airports and transfer activities when known.

arrival_longitude.description: Arrival longitude. Required for flight airports and transfer activities when known.

arrival_timezone.description: Arrival location IANA timezone. MCP clients must use this timezone to convert UTC arrival_at before displaying the local arrival date/time.

currency.description: ISO currency code for price, such as EUR or USD.

data.description: Optional raw transportation fields. Prefer the typed top-level fields when possible; values here are merged first. Supported transportation_type slugs: airplane, bike, bus, car, roadtrip, cruise, ferry, motorcycle, subway, train, transfer, walk. Labels: airplane = Flight; bike = Bike; bus = Bus; car = Car Rental; roadtrip = Drive / Road Trip; cruise = Cruise; ferry = Ferry; motorcycle = Motorcycle; subway = Subway; train = Train; transfer = Transfer; walk = Walk. Use only these exact slugs; custom categories are not supported for transportations.

departure_address.description: Full departure address. Required for transfer activities when known.

departure_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 departure timestamp when known. Timed values are always UTC; MCP clients must convert this value to departure_timezone before displaying the local departure date/time.

departure_description.description: Departure location name or description. For flights, use the departure airport IATA code such as JFK or FCO. For transfers, include the real place name.

departure_latitude.description: Departure latitude. Required for flight airports and transfer activities when known.

departure_longitude.description: Departure longitude. Required for flight airports and transfer activities when known.

departure_timezone.description: Departure location IANA timezone. MCP clients must use this timezone to convert UTC departure_at before displaying the local departure date/time.

name.description: Transportation segment name. For flights, omit name unless the user provided one.

provider_reservation_code.description: Provider-issued reservation, confirmation, or booking code for this transportation segment. Use this for booking/confirmation codes; use transport_number for the flight, train, bus, or service number.

transport_number.description: Flight, train, bus, or booking number when relevant.

transportation_type.description: Supported transportation type slug. For flights, use airplane. For transfer activities, use transfer. Supported transportation_type slugs: airplane, bike, bus, car, roadtrip, cruise, ferry, motorcycle, subway, train, transfer, walk. Labels: airplane = Flight; bike = Bike; bus = Bus; car = Car Rental; roadtrip = Drive / Road Trip; cruise = Cruise; ferry = Ferry; motorcycle = Motorcycle; subway = Subway; train = Train; transfer = Transfer; walk = Walk. Use only these exact slugs; custom categories are not supported for transportations.

vehicle_description.description: Vehicle description for cars, transfers, and roadtrips.
